title: Highlander Silver to Commence Trading on NYSE American Under Symbol “HSLV”
summary: Toronto, Ontario, March 6, 2026 – Highlander Silver Corp. (TSX: HSLV; “Highlander Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has received approval to list its common shares on the NYSE American LLC with trading expected to commence on Wednesday, March 11, 2026 under the symbol “HSLV”. The Company will remain listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the same symbol.
body_markdown: Toronto, June 25, 2026 – Highlander Silver Corp. (TSX, NYSE American: HSLV) (“Highlander Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to report on a comprehensive geophysical study of the Corani Silver Project integrating historical datasets with the first airborne magnetic survey and more extensive induced polarization-resistivity surveys than historically undertaken.
